$comment: Illustration subjects, drawn in the brand's own graphic language: characters on a lattice, faint ink with blue only where the site puts it. Each subject names its source in the brand's site (opencommerce-agentcard-web) or the image tool (agd-playground src/components/opencommerce-og/draw.ts). Rules are in brand/illustration.md.

field.description: The field of * and @: clumps from a noise map that crumble at their coasts, faint ink with short blue runs deep inside, feathering out toward the edges.
field.source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/scatter-stage.tsx and src/lib/noise.ts; draw.ts drawGlyphs

window.description: A window (mist bar, dimmed arrow, a file-like name, the blue [*]) with code on its blue band, or your --image, and the field gathering round it.
window.source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/window.tsx and globals.css (THE WINDOW); draw.ts drawWindow and drawSplit

mark.description: The [*] as a solid slab drawn in characters on a fine grid, shaded from a point light; the brightest faces turn blue.

orbit.description: The hero's system without its stores: nine flat rings of dots nested round the [*] slab, the far side fainter and passing behind it.
orbit.source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/merchant-orbit.tsx (rings and sun; the store tiles are third-party marks and are left out)

halftone.description: Your --image drawn in characters on the mark's fine grid: darker tones take denser glyphs from the mark's ramp, the darkest turn blue, white stays white.
halftone.source: the mark's shading in src/components/merchant-orbit.tsx (SUN_RAMP, lit cells in blue) and the halftone drawings in src/components/hero-ascii.ts (pictures sampled into characters)
